title: Renovation Control Tower Scorecard
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:ops workstream=* on_track=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(on_track="yes",1,0))) as matched by workstream
| eval on_track_status_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - on_track_status_pct
description: Measures the percentage of renovation workstreams that end with on-track status by workstream.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which workstream are helping or hurting renovation workstreams.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `on-track status` on `reno:ops` events and summarize the hit rate by `workstream`.
visualization: Table of workstream with percentage of renovation workstreams ending with on-track status.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how often on-track status happens for each workstream so you can see where renovation workstreams go smoothly or get stuck.
